parsed.name: OpenPLC 可编程逻辑控制系统
parsed.description: 一种用于工业与实验室自动化的可编程逻辑控制系统，可运行控制逻辑并通过 OPC UA 与 SCADA、HMI 或上位机通信，适合教学平台、测试台和小型自动化实验集成。
parsed.description_en: A programmable logic control system for industrial and laboratory automation that runs control logic and communicates with SCADA, HMI, or supervisory software over OPC UA. It is suitable for teaching setups, test benches, and small automation integrations.
